name: save-boundary-no-cycle-recheck
body: The save boundary judges the assembled §4 rules over the dirty rows alone, so a `contains`/`publishes` cycle routed through unchanged held rows is not re-detected at save; lint and merge remain the whole-model check. Upgrade if a save-time cycle guard is ever required — it would have to run over the held set, not the dirty set, since the cycle can be entirely outside what this save writes.
